main.description: Delete one device's text style override. This is the cleanup half of per-device preferences: a browser whose local storage is cleared can no longer find its own row, so without a way to delete rows by hand they accumulate for ever. Acts on the caller's own space and can only ever delete the caller's own row.

error.description: A stable machine code the client branches on — add codes, never rename them. `no-such-device` is NOT an error the player should see as a failure: deleting a row that is already gone got them what they wanted.
